name: Craftsman's Writ: Steel Weapon Chain

angles.text: As a blacksmith, you can forge the steel weapon chain yourself, turning your metalwork directly into trade payment.

faq.answer: The note asks for a single steel weapon chain.
faq.q: What item does the writ ask for?

faq.answer: Anyone carrying the document can fulfill the order, as the note is marked transferable.
faq.q: Can someone else deliver the order?

faq.answer: The order must be taken to the delivery spot marked on your map.
faq.q: Where do you deliver the finished chain?

faq.answer: You must carry the writ with you to conclude the trade and receive payment.
faq.q: Do you need to hold the writ to finish the delivery?

sections.body: A customer has drawn up a trade order in faded ink, asking for one steel weapon chain. The note details the payment offered and directs you to a drop-off spot marked on your map. Because the agreement is transferable, whoever holds the paper can finish the trade.
sections.title: An Order for Steel

summary: A customer has penned a trade note requesting a steel weapon chain, complete with payment terms and delivery instructions. You hold a transferable agreement that lets any bearer provide the forged metalwork and collect the trade fee.
attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Steel Weapon Chain
